driver: common/driver.cu: gptq_repack_kernel<<<dim3(m/2, n/64), 32>>>(in, out, m, n); args m n default 2 64 -> grid (1,1), one 32-lane warp. Host reference replays the kernel's two phases lane by lane and prints mismatches=0/128 if correct.
input: W = int32 [2,64] filled by a fixed LCG (every word packs eight 4-bit values); output [m/2, 2n] = 128 words.
access_estimate: about 2.3e3 thread-level memory accesses (per lane: unpack 2 x (2 global LD + 16 STS.U8) = 36, repack 4 x (8 LDS.U8 + 1 global ST) = 36; 32 lanes). Hard bound 1e4.
kernels_in_sm89_sass: cuobjdump -sass: gptq_repack_kernel(unsigned int*, unsigned int*, int, int) present in driver.sm_89.cubin (one sm_89 ELF, PTX sm_89 also embedded by -arch=sm_89); 1 kernel in the cubin.
